cues.en: Meet Mr. Archimedes of ancient Greece. Long ago, Archis said, give me a lever long enough and I can move the world. What Archimedes meant was that the power of a lever is practically unlimited. Today, almost everyone uses some form of lever in his daily work. The familiar can opener is a lever with a sharp cutting edge. The playground seesaw
cues.zh: 来认识一下古希腊的阿基米德先生。很久以前，阿基米德说，给我一根足够长的杠杆，我就能撬动世界。阿基米德的意思是，杠杆的力量几乎是无限的。今天，几乎每个人在日常工作中都会用到某种形式的杠杆。常见的开罐器就是带锋利刃口的杠杆。游乐场的跷跷板

cues.en: is just a simple lever too. It takes a lot of force to start a freight car moving, yet the railroad man can start the heaviest freight cars easily with a pinch bar, a powerful lever which turns the wheel. Tough luck, old boy. Here's a place where a lever comes in mighty handy. Let's take the simplest kind of lever, a rigid bar working on a fixed support called a fulcrum.
cues.zh: 也只是个简单的杠杆。要让一节货车车厢动起来需要很大的力，但铁路工人用一根撬棍就能轻松启动最重的货车车厢，那是一根能转动车轮的强力杠杆。真倒霉，老伙计。这里正是杠杆大显身手的地方。我们来看最简单的杠杆，一根在固定支点上工作的刚性杆，这个支点叫支点。

cues.en: One end of this lever is twice as long as the other. Let's put a 10-pound weight on this end, and now we'll put half as much weight on this end. Five pounds, balance 10. If we have 25 pounds to lift, we just use a longer lever. The five pounds will now balance five times as much. Let's raise the lever in the air, change its shape a little, and we have a crank.
cues.zh: 这根杠杆的一端是另一端的两倍长。我们在这端放一个10磅的重物，现在在这端放一半的重量。5磅，平衡10磅。如果我们要举起25磅，只要用更长的杠杆。这5磅现在能平衡五倍的重量。我们把杠杆举到空中，稍微改变一下形状，就得到了一个曲柄。

cues.en: Or we can add a second lever and have a double crank. Now the short arm moves one-fourth the distance, but we get four times the force. If we want continuous motion, we need more arms. Now we have levers that turn. The larger paddle wheel makes fewer turns, but it delivers more force. A paddle wheel is nothing but a never-ending series of levers. We can make the wheels stronger,
cues.zh: 或者我们可以加第二根杠杆，得到一个双曲柄。现在短臂移动的距离是四分之一，但我们得到四倍的力。如果想要连续运动，就需要更多的臂。现在我们有了会转动的杠杆。较大的桨轮转得圈数更少，但输出的力更大。桨轮不过是一系列永无止境的杠杆。我们可以把轮子做得更结实，

cues.en: and lessen friction where the wheels touch each other by rounding off the edges and shaping them into teeth that will slide in and out smoothly. Now, the power flows smoothly and continuously through spinning leverage of gear wheels. Gears are made in many kinds and many sizes. Little gears, big gears, worm gears, bevel gears, and even lopsided gears.
cues.zh: 并通过把边缘倒圆、做成能平滑进出的齿形，来减少轮子相互接触处的摩擦。现在，动力通过齿轮旋转的杠杆作用平稳而连续地流动。齿轮有多种类型和多种尺寸。小齿轮、大齿轮、蜗轮、锥齿轮，甚至还有不对称的齿轮。

cues.en: Over a hundred million gears are spinning over the roads in the transmissions of our automobiles. The transmission is located right at the bottom of the gear shift lever. Let's start from scratch and put together a model of the gears that we shift in our motor car. The shaft on the left comes from the engine. The shaft on the right carries the power back to the rear wheels. To connect these two with gears, we'll need another shaft.
cues.zh: 马路上有上亿个齿轮在汽车的变速箱里转动。变速箱就在换挡杆的正下方。我们从零开始，拼一个汽车换挡齿轮的模型。左边的轴来自发动机。右边的轴把动力传回后轮。要用齿轮连接这两根轴，还需要另一根轴。

cues.en: known as a counter shaft. These two gears carry the power from the engine shaft to the counter shaft and are always connected or in mesh. This gear on the drive shaft going to the wheels is free to turn around the shaft. We'll put it in mesh with another gear on the counter shaft. These gears are always in mesh and keep turning while the engine is running.
cues.zh: 叫中间轴。这两个齿轮把动力从发动机轴传到中间轴，而且始终连接、也就是常啮合。通往后轮的驱动轴上这个齿轮可以在轴上自由转动。我们把它和中间轴上的另一个齿轮啮合。这些齿轮始终啮合，发动机运转时就一直在转。

cues.en: To switch from one set of gears to another, our transmission needs a short shaft like this, known as a clutch sleeve. It cannot turn on the driveshaft, but it is free to slide back and forth. On the sleeve, we'll mount a large gear, which we can shift back and forth to mesh with the small gear in the middle of the countershaft. We are now in neutral. The gears that are always in mesh
cues.zh: 要切换不同齿轮组，变速箱需要这样一根短轴，叫离合器套筒。它不能在驱动轴上转动，但可以前后滑动。在套筒上装一个大齿轮，可以前后移动，去和中间轴中部的小齿轮啮合。现在就是空挡。始终啮合的齿轮

cues.en: are turning over with the engine. But the shaft to the rear wheels is standing still. A 3,000 pound automobile takes a lot of force to start. So in low speed, we get the greatest leverage by letting the smallest gear on the countershaft turn the largest gear on the driveshaft. The engine on this model is running at a constant speed of 90 revolutions a minute. With low gears in mesh,
cues.zh: 随着发动机一起转，但通往后轮的轴还是静止的。一辆3000磅的汽车起步需要很大的力。所以低速时，我们让中间轴上最小的齿轮带动驱动轴上最大的齿轮，从而获得最大的杠杆力。这个模型里发动机以每分钟90转的恒定速度运转。低速齿轮啮合时，

cues.en: The rear wheel is turning at 30 revolutions a minute, about a third the speed of the engine, but with three times the force. The power is going through these gears in the transmission. After we've started the car rolling, we want fast pickup. So we shift into second by sliding the sleeve backward to mesh with this gear on the shaft to the rear wheels. The wheel is now turning at 60 revolutions a minute.
cues.zh: 后轮以每分钟30转转动，大约是发动机转速的三分之一，但力是三倍。动力就是通过变速箱里的这些齿轮传递的。车起步之后，我们想要快速加速。于是后移套筒挂二挡，让它和通往后轮轴上的这个齿轮啮合。现在车轮以每分钟60转转动。

cues.en: and the power flows through these gears. For higher speeds, we let the power go directly to the rear wheels. We shift the sleeve forward so that it meshes with the shaft from the engine. The power travels straight from the engine to the drive shaft. Now the shaft to the wheels is turning at 90 revolutions a minute, the same speed as the engine. But here's a problem.
cues.zh: 动力通过这些齿轮传递。为了获得更高车速，我们让动力直接传到后轮。我们将套筒向前推，使其与来自发动机的轴啮合。动力直接从发动机传递到传动轴。现在连接车轮的轴以每分钟 90 转的速度旋转，与发动机同速。但这里有一个问题。

cues.en: An automobile must be able to go backward as well as forward. So we add one more set of gears to reverse the shaft to the rear wheels. With the gears shifted into reverse, the power travels through the transmission in a path like this. We now have three sets of spinning levers for going forward and one for reverse. With a gear shift lever, we can shift to any set of gears we wish.
cues.zh: 汽车不仅要能前进，还必须能倒车。因此我们增加了一组齿轮，用来反转通向后轮的轴。挂入倒挡后，动力在变速箱中的传递路径就是这样。现在我们有三组用于前进的旋转杠杆，一组用于倒车。通过换挡杆，我们就能切换到所需的任意一组齿轮。

cues.en: But with all these spinning levers in the transmission came noise and wear. Experts could shift gears quietly by careful timing of the gear shift and the engine speeds, but most of us made plenty of noise until new engineering developments made possible a long series of improvements that followed. When we shifted gears, we got a clash because the gears were not running at the same speed. In other words, not...
cues.zh: 但变速箱里有了这么多旋转杠杆，也随之带来了噪音与磨损。老手可以通过精准把握换挡时机与发动机转速来平顺换挡，但我们大多数人换挡时都会发出刺耳的打齿声，直到工程技术的全新突破催生了随后的一系列改进。以前换挡时会打齿撞击，是因为齿轮转速不一致。换句话说，就是没有……

cues.en: synchronized. So engineers set to work to develop a synchronizer. The synchronizer works like a cork twisted into the top of a bottle. The cork will turn until it is so tight that the bottle turns with it. Synchro mesh works the same way. When we shift into second or high, the synchronizer brings the gears to the same speed before they come together. The drums won't let the gear shift
cues.zh: 同步。于是工程师们着手研发同步器。同步器的工作原理就像把软木塞拧紧到瓶口里。木塞不断旋转，直到越拧越紧带动瓶子一起转动。同步啮合机构也是同样的原理。当我们挂入二挡或高速挡时，同步器会在齿轮啮合前将它们的速度调整一致。制动鼓不允许挂挡，

cues.en: unless they are turning at the same speed. When the gears come together, there is no clash, and the shift is made quietly and easily. In the transmission of the up-to-date automobile, we have a powerful low gear to give us a strong spinning leverage in starting. A fast turning motor must set the weight of the car in motion. In second speed, we can change leverage to get going fast at the same engine speed.
cues.zh: 除非它们的转速达到一致。齿轮啮合时便不会再打齿碰撞，换挡也变得安静而顺畅。在现代汽车的变速箱中，强劲的低速挡能在起步时提供巨大的旋转杠杆力。快速运转的发动机必须驱动沉重的车身起步。挂入二挡后，我们可以调整杠杆比，在相同的发动机转速下跑得更快。

cues.en: With the leverage of third gear, power goes directly to the rear wheels, and we can go as fast as we want. Now every driver can shift gears at any time, regardless of speed. Here is a hill that will give us a real chance to see how smoothly and reliably our spinning levers work in our automobile transmission. This driver is going to let her car gain a speed of 60 miles an hour down the hill. Then she will shift into second speed.
cues.zh: 借助三档的杠杆作用，动力直接传递到后轮，我们可以随心所欲地加速。现在，无论车速如何，每个司机都可以随时换挡。这里有一个坡，能让我们真正有机会看看汽车变速箱里的旋转杠杆工作得是多么平稳可靠。这位女司机将让她的车顺着山坡加速到每小时 60 英里。然后她将换入二档。

cues.en: and bring her car easily and safely under control before it reaches the bottom of the hill.
cues.zh: 并在车到达坡底之前，轻松安全地将车速控制住。
